measurement: Use wait4 on the owned complete Python driver process, whose waited-for MCP runtime child is included by Linux child accounting; includes Python imports, input/binary checks, all RPCs, final receipt writes and shutdown
failure_handling: Retain failed exit and existing partial output; terminate only the owned child process group if the outer deadline is exceeded
source_binding: Verify frozen driver/protocol and externally supplied qualified binary hash before execution; recheck driver/protocol after complete child exit
overlap: Inner driver and inner child CPU/wall timers are nested within wait4/outer observations and must not be added to them
rss_scope: wait4 maximum resident-set high-water field, not a sum of concurrent process RSS
